description: Step 3 of nap-ablation series on exp134 (E=64 saturated 468M). Change out_proj only: nap 8->6, tph 2304->3056. Pair coverage stays ~100% (samples 18336 vs pool C(192,2)=18336). qk and v back to nap=8/tph=256. Per-layer LUT: qk 25.17M, v 12.58M, out 12.58M (was 37.75M, 3x lighter — table_dim 256->64 with 1.32x more tables). Total per-layer 50.33M (was 75.5M). 6 layers: 302M LUT + ~15M = ~317M. Tests whether out_proj — the largest, widest module — needs nap=8 once pair coverage is saturated.
